Armijo, J., & Philibert, C. (2020). Flexible production of green hydrogen and ammonia from variable solar and wind energy: Case study of Chile and Argentina. International Journal of Hydrogen Energy, 45(3), 1541-1558. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijhydene.2019.11.028

Most of the paper is site optimisation (levelized costs by location), kept in _site-results. The technology rows are its Table 5 and Table 7 assumptions, which it takes from the literature (electrolyser refs [56-62]; Haber-Bosch from Philibert 2017b, registered as philibert_2017_002). On 2026-09-25 the levelized costs of hydrogen (Table 6) and ammonia (Tables 8-9) moved from _site-results to the main file as cost-levelized, one row per site and flexibility case, with discount-rate rows for the ammonia plant.
